senses.sense_definition: A hard, reddish-purple igneous rock containing distinct embedded crystals, prized historically for sculptures and monuments.

examples.text: The ancient Roman sarcophagus was carved out of deep red Egyptian <w>porphyry</w>.
Sculptures made of red <w>porphyry</w> symbolized imperial status and authority.

senses.sense_definition: Any igneous rock composed of large crystals embedded within a fine-grained silicate groundmass.

examples.text: Geologists discovered a large vein of quartz <w>porphyry</w> near the dormant volcano.
The sample of <w>porphyry</w> displays prominent feldspar crystals in a darker matrix.

senses.sense_definition: A Neoplatonic philosopher from Tyre who lived during the Roman Empire and edited the works of Plotinus.

examples.text: The philosophical writings of <w>Porphyry</w> significantly influenced early Christian and medieval thought.
Scholars often consult <w>Porphyry</w> for his famous introduction to Aristotle's categories.
